description: This is a documentation file describing a hardware abstraction layer (HAL) interface for composite video input ports on a platform. It details the architecture, API definitions, lifecycle, capabilities, event handling, and usage patterns for the composite input HAL, primarily used in embedded or smart TV platforms.

classes.name: PlatformCapabilities
classes.description: Describes global capabilities of the composite input platform, such as supported features and hardware capabilities.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Specifies capabilities of individual port, including supported properties, metrics, and features.

classes.name: Port
classes.description: Metadata about a specific port, including name, description, and hardware info.

classes.name: PortStatus
classes.description: Current status of a port, including connection status, signal quality, and video mode.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enumeration defining possible signal states such as NO_SIGNAL, UNSTABLE, STABLE, NOT_SUPPORTED.

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Details the video resolution, format, interlacing, and standard detection info.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Telemetry metrics such as lock time, drops, and uptime.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pairing for batch property read/write operations.

classes.name: PropertyMetadata
classes.description: Describes supported property keys, types, and capabilities within a port.

methods.name: getPlatformCapabilities
methods.description: Returns capabilities info of the platform-wide features and support.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Retrieves list of available port IDs.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Gets the interface for a specific port by ID.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns capabilities for a specific port.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Queries a specific property value of the port.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the port (video presentation).

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for port events such as connection and signal changes.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves telemetry metrics for the port, if supported.

methods.name: registerTelemetryListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for periodic telemetry updates.
